title: BlazePhoenix-Dex — on-chain liquidity aggregation with the route derived inside the executing transaction: source, verification apparatus and papers (v2.2)
description:
BlazePhoenix-Dex is an on-chain DEX aggregator in Solidity/Yul for Base, Ethereum, Optimism and Arbitrum whose route is solved on-chain inside the transaction that executes it. This record archives the repository at the release tagged papers-v2.2, which carries the two papers in docs/papers/: the Technical Whitepaper, Version 2.2 (the aggregator alone: the Meta-Equation, the Eightfold Dispatcher, deterministic derivation, the Iron-Law floor, the two fee regimes, the quote surfaces and how a quote ages, the security model, and the verification apparatus measured — a curated mutation guard of 203 mutants, covering arrays of strength 2 and 3 over the regime factors, N-version testing of the quote maths, fee-mutant detection rates with Wilson intervals) and the Litepaper, Version 2.2 (the same protocol for a general reader). Every figure in the papers is recomputed from a clean checkout by a named command in docs/assurance/.

Paper text: CC BY 4.0. Solidity source: BUSL-1.1 (cite the architecture; do not redeploy).
notes: Version 2.2 supersedes the PDF Version 2.1 (August 2026) and the interim markdown text labelled 3.0 (2026-09-01). The staking engine is specified in its own paper and is not part of this record's papers beyond a reference.
